bindingDecisions: Trust BlockNote default editor surfaces for attachment insertion and manipulation.
Remove Jixia top Attach shortcut UI from the primary editor surface.
Remove ready-state Jixia hover controls such as Open, Replace, and Remove for images/files.
Jixia owns hidden server semantics only: private attachment ids, upload confirmation, authorization, safe metadata, signed download resolution.
Do not regress Task20j default codeBlock behavior or server-first upload behavior, and do not regress Task20k content-first ready rendering.
preparation.rootProblem: Task20k removed the permanent management panel but still added custom visible Jixia chrome. Mature editors keep document content clean and put operations into native block/editor surfaces.
preparation.firstImplementationPriority: Delete/demote product-visible Attach and ready-state attachment hover controls; preserve native BlockNote image/file display and uploadFile/server semantics.

noSuccessWithout: No top-level Jixia Attach shortcut/control is required or visible as the primary attachment insertion path
Ready images render as BlockNote-native image content with no Jixia Open/Replace/Remove hover toolbar
Ready files render as compact BlockNote-like/default file content with no Jixia Open/Replace/Remove hover toolbar
Attachment insertion still works through BlockNote-native slash/menu/file/paste/drop paths where supported
Uploading, empty, dragging, and error placeholders retain necessary affordances without leaking into ready state
Notebook and Project save, refresh, reopen, signed download/render, and safe persistence remain working
Manual visual review confirms the document body has no Jixia custom attachment chrome in ready states
forbiddenCompletionClaims: Hover controls are less ugly, therefore they are acceptable
Top Attach is convenient for developers, therefore it should stay in the editor body
Upload still works, therefore BlockNote-native UX is complete
Tests pass, therefore human visual review is unnecessary

whatPassed: Manual reviewer reported Task20l review success after restarting the server-first LAN fixture stack
Ready image/file states no longer expose Jixia top Attach chrome or ready-state Open/Replace/Remove hover toolbar
Task20l machine implement/check/finish phases passed and stopped at the human visual gate before this review result
manualReview.remainingProductGap: The document body is now cleaner, but the whole document visual system still lacks mature typography, spacing, block rhythm, selection/hover/focus polish, and page baseline compared with Notion/Obsidian/mature editors.
